Package tasktracker.controller

Class TaskController

  • java.lang.Object
    • tasktracker.controller.TaskController
  • public class TaskController
extends java.lang.Object
    Coordinates task operations between the views and persistence layer. Permission checks are enforced here before TaskDAO changes stored data.

    • Method Detail

      • createTask

        public Task createTask​(java.lang.String title,
                       java.lang.String description,
                       User assignee,
                       java.time.LocalDate dueDate,
                       Priority priority)
                throws java.sql.SQLException
        Creates an open task owned by the logged-in user.
        Parameters:
        title - nonblank title, trimmed before storage
        description - optional description; null becomes empty and whitespace is trimmed
        assignee - persisted user, or null for unassigned
        dueDate - due date, or null for none
        priority - priority, or null for MEDIUM
        Returns:
        persisted task with its generated ID
        Throws:
        java.lang.IllegalStateException - if no user is logged in
        java.lang.IllegalArgumentException - if the title is blank or a user ID is not positive
        java.sql.SQLException - if database access fails, including a foreign-key violation

      • updateTask

        public boolean updateTask​(int taskId,
                          java.lang.String title,
                          java.lang.String description,
                          User assignee,
                          java.time.LocalDate dueDate,
                          Priority priority)
                   throws java.sql.SQLException
        Updates details only when the logged-in user is the creator.
        Parameters:
        taskId - positive ID of an existing task
        title - nonblank title, trimmed before storage
        description - optional description; null becomes empty and whitespace is trimmed
        assignee - persisted user, or null for unassigned
        dueDate - due date, or null for none
        priority - priority, or null for MEDIUM
        Returns:
        true if one stored task was changed; false if no row was changed
        Throws:
        java.lang.IllegalStateException - if no user is logged in
        java.lang.IllegalArgumentException - if the ID is invalid or the task is missing; also if the title is blank or a user ID is not positive
        java.lang.SecurityException - if the current user lacks permission
        java.sql.SQLException - if database access fails, including a foreign-key violation

      • assignTask

        public boolean assignTask​(int taskId,
                          User assignee)
                   throws java.sql.SQLException
        Assigns or unassigns a task only for its creator.
        Parameters:
        taskId - positive ID of an existing task
        assignee - persisted user, or null to unassign
        Returns:
        true if one stored task was changed; false if no row was changed
        Throws:
        java.lang.IllegalStateException - if no user is logged in
        java.lang.IllegalArgumentException - if the ID is invalid or the task is missing; also if the supplied assignee ID is not positive
        java.lang.SecurityException - if the current user lacks permission
        java.sql.SQLException - if database access fails, including a foreign-key violation
